events.title: ✨🏡 The Ellsydia Demo is Finally Here! 🏡✨
events.summary: Hi everyone,I’m thrilled to announce that the Ellsydia demo is now available on Steam! 🎉As a solo developer, I wanted to create a small cozy village-builder where relaxation comes before complexity. events.summary: Hey everyone !Every month, i'm sharing with you the advancement on my game Ellsydia, a small medieval City builder. events.title: ✨ Playtest is OVER ✨
events.summary: Hey everyone!Thank you so much to all the playtesters who tested the game and gave me so much valuable feedback, it will really help me improve Ellsydia.Since it was my first playtest session that I organized and ran for one of my games, I was very nervous before launching. All of you sent me so many kind words that my stress dropped away very fast!Now it's time to read, sort, and prioritize all the feedback and reported issues to fix and implement starting Monday.Thank you all for your help and

events.title: ✨ Ellsydia Playtest is LIVE! ✨🏡
events.summary: Hey everyone!I'm excited to announce that the Ellsydia Playtest has launched and is now LIVE!You can still join if you want to test the game and help me to improve it! Don't hesitate to sign up before the last day of the session! 😉Join me on Discord or, fill out this playtest request form, if you want to participate.The session will end Friday, September 25 at 10:00 AM PDT.Thank you so much for your help and support! ✨– David "Pixilluzion" ❤️

events.title: ✨🏡 Very First Ellsydia Playtest! 🏡✨
events.summary: Hey everyone!I am finally running the very first playtest for Ellsydia!The playtest starts this Monday, September 21 at 10:00 AM PDT, and I can't wait (and am also very stressed) to get your first feedback about my little game.Keep in mind that this is a work in progress version of the game. Some features are unfinished, unbalanced, and may change before the release of the final game.
